name: Redmine
description: Redmine is a flexible project management web application. It handles multiple projects with per-project roles, issue tracking with custom fields and workflows, Gantt charts and calendars, wikis, forums, time tracking and repository browsing for Git, Subversion and Mercurial.

notes.text: Sign in as admin with the generated password from /opt/redmine_data/.env inside the container.
Email notifications stay off until email_delivery is set in /opt/redmine_data/configuration.yml; restart the redmine service afterwards.

app_vars.name: var_admin_pass
app_vars.label: Admin Password
app_vars.help: At least 8 characters; generated when left empty
